LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_Frogman.label: directed chassis gestation
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_Frogman.description:
A sealed technique that cultivates artificial military organisms in place of printing mechs. A directed development sequence is written into an embryo, whose mesonuclear substrate then lays down synthetic-mechanical structure instead of biological tissue and matures on its own. The embryo is brought to term in a growth vat.

Further AMO development was stopped for good after a catastrophic incident in the Earth era. Self-developing military organisms do enormous harm to local society and productive capacity, and the technology has been proscribed ever since. The colonial fleets carry out the sanctions under this ban themselves, never through local authorities.

Unlocks the XM132 Frogman and its development sequence.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_Frogman.discoveredLetterTe:
Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology: the XM132 Frogman, the earliest artificial military organism humanity is known to have put into development.

The Frogman's directed development sequence can now be produced. Culture an embryo at an artifuscle chamber, then bring it to term in a growth vat or a surrogate. The result is a biomatroid larva. Protect its gestation pod for five days and it will develop into a combat-ready Frogman.

The file carries a fleet prohibition notice. Producing AMOs is prohibited on any settled world, and the fleets enforce this ban in person.
